instruction.text: Sasha is walking around her village. Fill in the gaps to describe Sasha’s movement from the cinema to her home.

atoms.b: Sasha walked ((++forward backward)) in a ((++straight wiggly)) line and turned ((++once twice)) to go home.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Sasha’s movement from her home to the vets.

atoms.b: Sasha left home and walked in a ((++straight wiggly)) line onto the road. After making a ((++quarter half)) turn in an anticlockwise direction, Sasha walked ((++forward backward)) in a straight line.

At the crossroads, Sasha made another ((++quarter half)) turn in a ((++clockwise anticlockwise)) direction, and carried on walking forward. To enter the vets, Sasha made a final ((++quarter half)) turn in an anticlockwise direction.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Sasha’s movement from her home to the pharmacy.

atoms.b: Sasha walked ((++forward backward)) in a straight line. After the crossroads, Sasha made a ((++quarter three-quarter)) turn in an ((clockwise ++anticlockwise)) direction to arrive at the pharmacy.
